deviations.what: I'm-new subtitle (c1 O2a) ends with the SMS sentence 'We'll send a 6-digit code by SMS.'
deviations.reason: The code goes by SMS only and the number step names it on both doors (the sign-in frame L2 does); c1 O2a predates the SMS ruling. C-25-1 asserts it

deviations.what: The I'm-new code step says 'Sent by SMS to …' where c1 O2b says 'Sent to …'
deviations.reason: Both doors share one code step; the newer frame (c1b L3) names SMS
deviations.authority: ADR 2026-10-05c §1–§2 (both doors use the same S0.2 code screen; SMS only)

deviations.what: Send code is disabled in the theme's disabled colours (muted fill) rather than the frame's solid grey
deviations.reason: The disabled look comes from the theme's FilledButton, shared by every screen
deviations.authority: app/lib/shared/theme.dart filledButtonTheme — outside this lane's folders

deviations.what: Keypad keys are square-cornered tiles with a 3 px gap; the c1/c1b frames round each key (~8 px) with a wider gap
deviations.reason: The keypad is the shared PinKeypad the lock and S0.8 use (drawn to c3 S15 'PIN instead', square tiles) so the three cannot drift; rounding it is a features/lock change for every PIN screen, outside this lane
deviations.authority: ADR 2026-10-05 §1 via c3/S15/PIN instead · six digits (the shared keypad's frame); app/lib/features/lock/widgets/pin_pad.dart owner

deviations.what: Body copy (bodyLarge subtitles and leads) draws with Material's inherited tracking at 16 px where the canvas sets 15.5 px untracked, so lines break a word or two earlier than the frame
deviations.reason: No token defines tracking and RkType.body sets none, so ThemeData merges the M3 default letterSpacing; the fix is one line in rkTextTheme for every screen (open item to the theme owner, as on S0.8). 15.5 px maps to the body role by rule
deviations.authority: app/lib/shared/theme.dart rkTextTheme — outside this lane's folders; ADR 2026-10-05 §1 (tokens.json decides values: type.body 16)

deviations.what: The c1 step bar (2 of 6) draws only on S0.2 inside the F1 chain
deviations.reason: Draws what c1 O2a/O2b show; the shared F1 stepper (13 §4.1 'stepper progress') is not yet a component, so S0.3–S0.8 do not draw it — ⚠️ SPEC in s0_2_phone_otp_screen.dart

deviations.what: The inline links (c1b L2 'Set up instead', L3 'Change' / 'Send again') have a 44 dp hit area around the words, so the 'Sent by SMS to … Change' row is taller than the frame's text line; the gaps above and below it are tightened (s1 / s4) so the boxes land within a few px of c1b L3
deviations.reason: The canvas draws the links as bare text; that decides their look, not their hit area. They are the only way out of several code-step states, and a 32 dp target fails the locked target size (review finding 5, SIGNIN1A repair r1)
deviations.authority: design-system.md §3.1 rule 9 🔒 (target size ≥ 44 pt); 13 §8 (touch targets ≥ 44 dp); ADR 2026-10-05 §1 (accessibility is never overridden by a frame)

deviations.what: No visible change: the six code boxes carry an invisible system text field (oneTimeCode autofill hint, paste) over them
deviations.reason: Keeps the canvas keypad and boxes while restoring the platform's SMS one-time-code autofill and paste, so the code never has to be transcribed (review finding 2, SIGNIN1A repair r1). Nothing is drawn; listed so the pair is not mistaken for a field-less screen
deviations.authority: design-system.md §3.1 🔒 (WCAG 2.2 AA, SC 3.3.8 Accessible Authentication); ADR 2026-10-05 §1
